subject: general
question: What is the name of the online vaccine management portal that PM Modi has launched in October 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**U-WIN**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The U-WIN portal is designed to maintain a digital record of vaccinations and medications.**
 
• **It targets pregnant women and children from birth to 17 years of age.**
 
• Currently, the portal is operational on a pilot basis.
 
• PM Modi is expected to officially launch the portal in October 2024.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The portal will enhance the tracking and management of vaccinations in India.
 
• Union Health Minister J P Nadda announced the launch at a press conference regarding the government's achievements.
 
• The expanded Ayushman Bharat scheme will also be introduced alongside, benefiting senior citizens.
